tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation rejected two fits, while the structured, smooth reversal does not warrant abstention. The existing rows vary input across short horizons and horizon at a few inputs, leaving the nonlinear input saturation and adaptation timescales insufficiently identified. Acquire the available fine trajectory batch for informative variation before another numerical fit.

considered_alternatives.option: Refit the plain four-parameter dual-exponential reversal law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It was directly refuted on fresh confirmation, with confirm RMSE 1.95 versus tolerance 0.045.

considered_alternatives.option: Refit the sink-saturating dual-horizon law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The prior attempt using this family also failed confirmation (RMSE 0.91); the available rows do not yet distinguish remaining input/horizon dependence well enough.
The observations are smooth and sign reversal is coherent; no high-frequency oscillation signature or evidence that stationary mechanisms are excluded.
It is explicitly irrelevant to the target-law identifiability problem and needlessly costly.
